style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE male aardwolf, shaggy striped coat, mane up on his spine, teeth bared, jaw working on air when silent
second_characters: A SWARM of termites in tiny ties, at the lens every beat

props.tin: ONE open tin in his paw, boiling over with termites at 0.00, empty by 7.30

environment: noon savannah, tall red termite mounds crowding the frame, dry yellow grass, white sky
lighting: white daylight from above, hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right
motion_rule: The camera rides sideways alongside him and never stops, the mounds tearing past, whipping round at 2.10, 4.75 and 7.30; new shot size every beat, one hero action per beat, he throws his whole body a full length across frame every beat, he fills half the frame height, muzzle to the lens, medium to close; ONE termite in a tie crosses the lens every beat.

audio.rate: 3.8 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.30; then only wind and insect rattle
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking; the last termite enters the mouth at 7.35
audio.pronunciation: ter-MI-tov, NOCH-yu, pro-kor-MIT, ot-DAT, E-ta, mo-YO

timeline.a: already huge in frame, teeth bared, termites spilling at the lens, he hurls his whole body a full length past a red mound and sweeps A SWARM into the tin in his paw
he hurls his body across frame, the tin out at arm's length; a termite in a tie snatches a pawful out of it at the lens
he drives a full body length over the grass and rakes a fresh swarm off a mound into the tin
he hurls his body past two mounds; two tie termites tear across the lens with their haul
he wrenches his body the other way, swapping the tin to his other paw on the move; a column of tie termites sweeps the lens carrying his catch off
he throws his body a full length across frame, the tin nearly empty in his paw; tie termites boil across the lens
he thrusts the tin out across frame on the move, muzzle to the lens, ONE termite left on the rim; a tie termite sweeps the lens
he lunges muzzle first into the lens until he fills the frame and licks the last termite off the rim into his jaws and lets the tin fall from his paw; the tie termites peel off into the depth
he swallows, the lump rolling down his throat, and drives a full length across frame; A SWARM of tie termites hauls the empty tin across the lens in front of him
he tears across frame after the tin, snapping his jaws on empty air, the mounds tearing past
he hurls his body a full length across frame and bares his teeth at the lens as at 0.00, a fresh swarm boiling out of the mound behind him, one termite crawling up his muzzle

must_appear: the tin is in his paw from 0.00 and empty by 7.30; he licks the last termite off the rim at 7.30 and swallows it at 7.85; the tie termites haul the empty tin away at 7.85; the bared teeth at 0.00 repeat at 9.25
